title: BoxGeometry stretches one texture tile over every face (streaks, 'planks')
summary: BoxGeometry maps 0..1 onto every face, so a 16 m slab stretches one tile into vertical streaks a critic reads as planks. Use metric UVs (module.any.metric-box) or a per-face repeat in metres.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

doc.when: Any textured box bigger than its texture tile.
doc.avoid: A single material repeat for all faces of a long thin box.
gotchas: The kit's box()/part() should default to metric UVs (engine request).

problem.symptom: Long streaks or 'plank' stripes on slabs and walls.
problem.cause: One 0..1 UV tile per face regardless of the face's size.
problem.fix: Metric UVs (1 UV per metre) + materials with repeat = 1 / tile metres.
problem.detect: Texture features stretched along the long axis of big faces.
